evidence.claim: On the n=50 overlap subset, Cohen kappa between judge.lenient-similarity and the exact-equality oracle is 0.72 (po=0.86, pe=0.5). Accuracy is 0.86 with 7 errors, all toward-match (false_match=7, false_mismatch=0).

extrapolation_judged_only.licensed_claim: judged-only scores carry this overlap-derived error bar; they are not licensed as oracle-grade

judge_swap.bound: Disagreement between the two judges on the same overlap cases is 7/50 (0.14). That is the trust ceiling for either judge used as an official scorer on judged-only items.

question: Implementation target: where a benchmark case can be scored by an exact algorithm, the platform must use the algorithm; where only a model judgement is available, the platform must report the judge agreement rate that licenses trusting it. Measure Cohen kappa between the judge and the deterministic oracle on the subset where both exist, then extrapolate the error bar onto the judged-only subset.
